## Reviewer's guide v1 — not for the author

> [!TIP]
> **This is the reviewer's guide.** Work through the ⚠️ checklist below, then approve — **approving asserts only that the ⚠️ items looked right to you.** Machine-verified this run: links, shortcodes, page metadata, and every claim marked verified (receipts on the evidence page). Code samples are read, not compiled.
>
> _PR author: your to-do list is the other review comment, "Author action guide" — nothing on this card is yours._

**Approval needed from:** @pulumi/docs-tools — any member's approval satisfies the merge gate.

> [!NOTE]
> **What this PR changes:**
>
> - The board's "Do next" batch strip is removed: `do_next_html`, `card_extra`, the card CSS, and the card half of the board's click script all go.
> - A new `analyze.attach_cluster_actions` puts a cluster's chain on its lead's row and its consolidation on the newest sweep's row, as decisions.
> - `chain` and `consolidate` join `DECISION_IDS`, so a row still takes only one of them.
> - A chain button carries `data-covers`; the board marks the next link "covered" while it is lit and puts the chain out if that row decides something else.
> - `action_bar` lets a chain outrank a bare approve for the coloured slot, and `action_help` now prefers an action's own `help` string.
> - `merge_judgments` rebuilds the cluster recommendations and the row buttons, not just `do_next`.
> - `queue.do_next` survives in the data model but is printed only by `--terminal`.
> - The three pr-review prose files are rewritten to match: the "Do next" sections become "Cluster moves" / "No batch strip".
>
> The wrongness that would matter here is a board that composes a command the approver did not intend — a button that acts on a row it should not, or two lit buttons that contradict each other. The review read the full diff, traced the new chain/consolidate guards against `cluster_recommendation` and `row_actions`, and checked the board script's new cover/contradiction path and the three prose files for leftover "Do next" claims.
>
> **Review confidence:**
>
> | Dimension | Level | Notes |
> | :--- | :---: | :--- |
> | mechanics | HIGH |  |
> | facts | HIGH |  |
> | board behaviour | MEDIUM | Not yours to check — the click sequences are covered by the jsdom test in this PR, which the review read but did not run; CI runs it. |
